description: A circulated 1964 Washington quarter, still 90% silver: worth its melt, 0.1808 troy oz of silver (US Mint figure: 0.18084 oz in a 6.25 g coin of 90% silver) times the price of the day. The range holds for silver from 18 to 110 dollars an ounce (the mill priced it at about 28 to 90 on 2026-11-12): a low from 3.25 to 20, a high to 35.

request.design: Washington portrait on the front, an eagle with spread wings on the back
request.gradeNotes: Even wear on the high points of the hair, a guess from the photo.
